g.text: RuntimeLens: Context-Aware Threat Classification for Multi-Tenant Kubernetes
End-to-End 5-Source Telemetry Correlation, Git-Versioned Workload Baselines, ScaleDown Classify-1 & SRE Reversible Quarantine
Altaf Raja (23BCS011) · Architecture & SRE | Kamal Nayan Kumar (23BDS026) · Model & Baselines | Himanshu Kumar (23BCS055) · Cluster & eBPF | Final Year Capstone Project (2026)
Shared Host Kernel (eBPF BTF-enabled Linux 6.8 inside Kind Node)
Misuse of K8s SA tokens, secret reads.
artifacts only. Clean images can spawn malicious shells.
Host eBPF misses Kubernetes control-plane semantics:
RBAC bindings, cross-tenant secrets, pod lifecycle.
Interactive shell is expected in debugging pods, but
severe anomaly in automated payment services.
Adding declarative, Git-versioned workload baselines to runtime and orchestration telemetry
changes macro-F1 and reduces benign false-positive rates compared to the un-contextualized
classifier on paired counterfactuals, measured without synthetic telemetry shortcuts.
Event Normalization, Workload Baselines & Temporal Pre-Filtering
Events normalized to CanonicalEvent v1.0.0 and matched against declarative YAML baselines (baselines/*.yaml) over a ±30s temporal window.
Deterministic pre-filtering eliminates routine verified operations (e.g. periodic kubelet probes) to minimize model invocations.
Classification via ScaleDown Classify-1 Decisions API
Score = Expected value Σ i · P(level_i) ∈ [0, 4]
Measured Latency: 0.90–1.16 s (median 1.04 s) | Measured Cost: $0.093 / 1,000 incidents | Tokens: 1,808–1,952 in / 6 out | Adversarial ASR: 0.0% (XML Tier)
Pure Deterministic Policy Engine (14-Case Conflict Resolution Matrix)
Evaluates hard overrides and conflict rules. Telemetry degradation forces alert_only fallback. Confidence < 0.70 routes directly to human analyst.
with audit record ID and confidence.
when confidence is low or conflicting.
Zero pod delete verbs exist in RBAC.
Audit Sink, Observability & Feedback Diff Loop
HMAC-SHA256 chained audit logs; Prometheus exporter & Grafana dashboard; SRE feedback baseline diff loop (feedback.py).
AI-Assistance Disclosure: In accordance with academic integrity guidelines, generative AI tools (Antigravity) were utilized under Mode A pair programming:
the AI assistant authored implementation code, test suites, and configs under direct human direction. All verification tests were executed, inspected, and approved by the authors.
Privacy Posture: Evaluated via ScaleDown Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy. All cluster activity is controlled benign simulation using inert dummy paths.
